protocol_expansion.reason: The v4b pre-start audit proved 50/50 TLE coverage but only 23/50 frozen transmitters were compatible with the seven receiver inventories and only 22 satellites received assignments. Expand receiver-band coverage before campaign start rather than misdescribe registered targets as schedulable targets.

protocol_notes.primary_scope: Read-only 50-target, ten-station shadow validation on public SatNOGS observations; no jobs are submitted.
protocol_notes.station_selection: Seven preregistered high-volume stations plus three connected, available, non-testing stations chosen outcome-blind by deterministic frequency set-cover with at least 10,000 prior observations.
protocol_notes.target_selection: The unchanged fifty outcome-blind, count-stratified transmitter targets with a retrievable pre-start CelesTrak TLE.
protocol_notes.frequency_coverage: Exact current SatNOGS antenna declarations cover the selected transmitter frequency of all 50 registered targets before geometry generation.
protocol_notes.weather: Open-Meteo and NOAA forecast bodies are frozen before each solve; terrestrial weather remains evaluation-only unless a predeclared held-out gate supports the optional model.
protocol_notes.space_weather: NOAA SWPC Kp is active when available; missing future intervals stay explicitly missing.
protocol_notes.hardware: Current SatNOGS antenna identities and ranges are hard constraints and their raw station-detail responses are hash-bound; gain/noise stay null without measured declarations.
protocol_notes.causal_boundary: A shadow run tests calibration, robustness and operational scheduling at scale, not causal yield improvement from executed recommendations.
